calls.title: Ashley / Tatev GAds synch, competitor campaign + tracking
calls.summary: The team discussed integrating HubSpot with Google Analytics via Zapier for enhanced tracking of meeting bookings and conversion data flow. They emphasized using Google Performance Max campaigns to retarget website visitors effectively and maintain clarity in audience targeting. A strategic shift to single-keyword ad groups was implemented to bolster campaign efficiency, elevating the click-through rate. Budget was allocated primarily for competitor targeting, focusing on Optimizely, VWO, and Adobe, while deprioritizing Harness. The importance of GrowthBook's case study, which demonstrated a 20x increase in tested traffic, was also highlighted to showcase its value proposition. Additionally, the team opted against fully migrating to Google Tag Manager due to performance concerns, favoring existing tools for tracking.
calls.keywords: HubSpot integration, Google Analytics tracking, Brand campaign optimization, PMAX campaigns, Competitor campaigns, LinkedIn retargeting

calls.title: Ashley / Tatev Synch on Ads
calls.summary: The team discussed strategies to improve Google Ads performance, highlighting the importance of quality traffic validated by engagement metrics. A target of at least 30 monthly conversions was established, with a need to update conversion tracking to include free product sign-ups. The shift in bidding strategy from maximizing clicks to maximizing conversions aims to enhance lead quality by focusing on high-intent users. Performance between branded and non-branded campaigns was monitored separately, revealing differing costs and traffic volumes. The team plans to target key competitors like Optimizely and Adobe while refining keyword strategies. Additionally, they aim to integrate CRM data with Google Ads for improved retargeting and explore LinkedIn for multi-touch engagement to support lead nurturing efforts.
calls.keywords: Google Ads, Conversion Tracking, Competitor Campaigns, Lifecycle Marketing, Rio Tool, LinkedIn Campaigns
